name: Ultimate Stock Portfolio Analyzer - Daily Report (Gmail + Notion)

nodes.name: Daily 6AM EST (Weekdays)
nodes.notes: Runs Monday-Friday at 6:00 AM. Timezone set to America/New_York in workflow settings.

nodes.name: Run Portfolio Analyzer
nodes.notes: Runs the analyzer with 5-minute timeout. Results exported as JSON.

nodes.name: Read Results JSON
nodes.notes: Reads the exported JSON results file.

nodes.name: Parse JSON Results
nodes.notes: Parses JSON, extracts verdicts, top picks, earnings alerts. Passes raw portfolio data for Notion.

nodes.name: Format Gmail Email
nodes.notes: Builds a styled HTML email with header, macro bar, top picks table, earnings alerts, and full portfolio grid. Also generates a plain-text fallback.

nodes.name: Send Gmail
nodes.notes: SETUP: 1) In n8n, go to Credentials > Add > Gmail OAuth2. 2) Follow the Google OAuth setup. 3) Update the credential ID here or re-select in the UI. 4) Set PORTFOLIO_EMAIL env var or edit the 'sendTo' field.

nodes.name: Update Notion Database
nodes.notes: SETUP: Set NOTION_API_KEY and NOTION_DATABASE_ID as environment variables. Each stock is upserted (created if new, updated if existing) based on the Ticker column.

nodes.name: Format Error Email
nodes.notes: Formats a styled HTML error email with diagnostic info.

nodes.name: Send Error Gmail
nodes.notes: Sends error notification to the same Gmail address.
